issues.issue: Whether the claimants face a personal risk from gang extortion or only generalized violence
issues.applicant_position: Mother died after gang extortion; family threatened after refusing to pay; police ignored complaint.
issues.result_text: Testimony credible, but generalized violence is not personal risk; claimant not entitled to protection.

issues.issue: Whether an internal flight alternative in Campeche or Mexico City is reasonable
issues.result_text: Campeche is a reasonable internal flight alternative where La Linea is absent.
